steps.title: Welcome
steps.body: A short setup to get this app ready. Nothing here is required; you can close it and come back later.

steps.title: Demo data (optional)
steps.body: Load a small example dataset so the lists, detail pages and dashboards show a working product straight away. The data is obviously sample data, it is safe to run more than once, and it can be removed afterwards. Skip this on a production install.

pages.title: Dashboard
pages._note: DashboardIndex is a self-contained view that renders a single CnDashboardPage (KPI cards + recent-activity list + quick-anonymization panel). It is mounted via type:"custom" so only one CnDashboardPage renders — wrapping it as a body widget of a type:"dashboard" page nested CnDashboardPage-in-CnDashboardPage (hydra dashboard-antipattern).

pages.title: Consent Management
pages._note: Consent objects are fetched from filinq's own PHP controller (not a plain OR index endpoint) and rendered via CnIndexPage with custom column formatters; type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: Consent Detail
pages._note: Detail fetched via consent store; sidebar driven by navigationStore.selected. Uses custom layout; type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: Custom dictionaries
pages._note: Dictionaries are fetched from filinq's own PHP controller (organisation-gated, term-count-enriched) not a plain OR index endpoint — same rationale as ConsentIndex; type:custom preserves that data path.

pages.title: Custom Dictionary Detail
pages._note: Term management (add/remove/import) + metadata edit for one dictionary, fetched via customDictionaryStore. type:custom preserves the filinq-controller data path.

pages.title: Anonymization
pages._note: Anonymization uses the anonymization store (filinq API) not OpenRegister; type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: Folder Analysis
pages._note: Folder-level anonymization scan; fetches via folderAnonymizationStore (filinq API); type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: Templates
pages._note: Decomposed to type:index (Phase 8): the template schema is OR-registered, so CnIndexPage lists the template objects directly. The bespoke lock/unlock/editor lives on TemplateDetail. `register` MUST be a register SLUG from lib/Settings/filinq_register.json — it was `filinq` from Phase 8 until 2026-08-03, a register Filinq has never shipped (the definition has declared `templates` since before Phase 8 landed), so this page listed a register that holds nothing while TemplatesController wrote to the `templates` register resolved from app config `template_register`.

pages.title: Template Detail
pages._note: Template detail view with lock/unlock, editor, and preview. Hybrid data path via templateStore.

pages.title: Letters & correspondence
pages._note: Letter/correspondence generation from templates with merge data (single or batch), via correspondenceStore + CorrespondenceController (generate/generateBatch/jobStatus). Hybrid data path; type:custom preserves it. Restored reachability — openspec/changes/orphaned-surface-restoration (REQ-DDOSR-003); the component and backend already existed, only the manifest/registry/menu wiring was missing.

pages.title: Signing Requests
pages._note: Decomposed to type:index (Phase 8): signingRequest is OR-registered in the `signing` register, so CnIndexPage lists the requests directly. (`register` was `filinq` from Phase 8 until 2026-08-03 — a register Filinq has never shipped; see the Templates note.) Per-request signing actions live on SigningRequestDetail. actionToggles.showAdd:false + primaryAction (openspec/changes/orphaned-surface-restoration, REQ-DDOSR-004) replace the generic bare-object Add dialog with the signer-chain SigningRequestForm page — the index's own create path was a dead end (writes a signingRequest with no signer chain, fields or provider).

pages.title: New Signing Request
pages._note: Signer-chain create form (documentFileId/documentName/signatureLevel/signingMode via signingStore.createSigningRequest — POST signing#createRequest, which drafts a signingRequest record; it does not send/sign/bind a provider — those remain separate signing#sign / not-yet-built provider-binding actions). Reachable from the SigningRequests index primaryAction. Restored — openspec/changes/orphaned-surface-restoration (REQ-DDOSR-004); trust/identity-assertion controls are gated to signing-trust-rebuild / signer-identity-rails per design.md D4 — this page composes a draft only.

pages.title: Signing Request Detail
pages._note: Signing request detail view driven by signingStore. Links to SignatureVerification (restored — REQ-DDOSR-004) for the document's file id. MUST stay declared AFTER the static /signing/new route: vue-router matches in declaration order, so a leading :id route swallows /signing/new.

pages.title: Signature Verification
pages._note: Read-only verify page over signing#verify/{fileId} (SigningVerificationService); renders the backend verdict verbatim, attributed to the signing engine — it does not compute or assert its own validity. Linked from SigningRequestDetail. Restored — openspec/changes/orphaned-surface-restoration (REQ-DDOSR-004).

pages.title: My Documents
pages._note: Hosts the in-app file viewer (FileViewerPage renders when fileViewerStore.currentFile is set). The anonymisation widget routes here after upload so the user reviews detected entities next to the document contents.

pages.title: Print Preview
pages._note: Standalone print-preview page; no nav item; launched programmatically.

pages.title: Document comparison
pages._note: Side-by-side document comparison (original vs anonymised output). Standalone page; no nav item; deep-linked with ?left=&right= file-id query params.

pages.title: Versions
pages._note: Document versions (Versies) — thin consumer of Nextcloud files_versions. Part of the ADR-001 document-detail family; standalone deep-linked page (?fileId=) like Comparison, no nav item. Lists/opens/downloads/restores/compares a document's file versions.

pages.title: Component gallery
pages._note: Living design-system reference for the reusable Dd* components (each shown with its variants/states). Self-contained view; standalone deep-linked page (/gallery), no nav item, like PrintPreview/Comparison/Versions.

pages.title: Publish never
pages._note: Entity-level publish-never rules (publicationProhibition) via PolicyController (indexProhibitions/createProhibition/showProhibition/updateProhibition/deleteProhibition) + PolicyMatchService. Deep-link reachable, no menu entry — the policy menu label/placement is owned by openspec/changes/publication-policy-labels-and-nav; this change (orphaned-surface-restoration, REQ-DDOSR-005) only restores the page's reachability. Modal is ProhibitionFormModal (registry kind:modal), its own file per ADR-004.

pages.title: Publish always
pages._note: Entity-level publish-always rules (publicationStandingConsent) via StandingConsentController (index/create/show/update/destroy) + PolicyRetroactiveService. Deep-link reachable, no menu entry — owned by publication-policy-labels-and-nav (see Prohibitions note). This change (orphaned-surface-restoration, REQ-DDOSR-005) only restores reachability. Modal is StandingConsentFormModal (registry kind:modal); the view's previous inline NcDialog was replaced with it to fix the hydra modal-isolation gate.

ADR-112 / ADR-114 Decision 3. All three are declarative type:dashboard pages over filinq's own register — no bespoke component and no per-app controller. Nothing moves here: filinq had no report surface at all before this, so these are new readings rather than relocated menu entries.
pages.title: Reports

config.description: Pick a report to open it.

cards.label: Signing
cards.description: Where each signing request stands, and what signers did with it.

cards.label: Anonymisation
cards.description: What is being anonymised, from where, and what failed.

cards.label: Documents produced
cards.description: What the templates generated, in which format, and what went out as correspondence.

pages.title: Signing
pages._note: The status enums here are UPPERCASE on signingRequest and signerRecord (DRAFT/PENDING/…), lowercase on anonymizationBatch and generatedDocument. Every filter is scalar equality, the only kind OpenRegister's aggregation endpoint can evaluate, and it does not fold case: a filter of "completed" against COMPLETED counts zero and reports it as zero.

content.emptyLabel: Nobody has been asked to sign yet

pages.title: Documents produced
pages._note: Two schemas, deliberately on one page: a generatedDocument is a template rendered, a correspondence is one sent to somebody. Splitting them would make the reader open two pages to answer one question.

pages.title: Flows
pages._note: ADR-110 Decision 4: a flow is app-specific, so the authoring surface lives here rather than behind a deep link to another app's list. An ordinary index over the named `flows` source (config.entitySource) rather than the deprecated `flows` page type, reading OpenRegister's one native flow store (ADR-065), scoped to this app by config.app.

pages.title: Flow
pages._note: The shared CnFlowDetail canvas over the same single engine. Controls render in the NC app sidebar (sidebarComponent) so the canvas keeps full width; canvas and sidebar share useFlowStore. The _note claimed this before the field existed, so #/flows/new -- and every #/flows/:id -- rendered a bare canvas with no way to name, describe, trigger or step-edit the flow. Mirrors pipelinq#1490.

observability._note: Consumed by OpenRegister's AppHost observability engine (ADR-006 / ADR-040). The GenericHealthController + GenericMetricsController read this block to serve /api/health (public) and /api/metrics (admin-only). Replaces the bespoke HealthController/MetricsController/MetricsCollector deleted in build/adopt-apphost-2026-06-16.

steps.title: Welcome to Filinq
steps.body: Let's take a quick spin through your document workspace. We'll set up a template and a signing request together so you can see how the pieces fit, and you'll add each record yourself.
Templates are the reusable documents you generate, anonymise and send. Open Templates from the menu to get started.
Add your first template. Give it a name and save. You can edit its content and reuse it for documents and signing requests later.
steps.task: Click New and save a template

steps.body: Signing requests track documents sent out for signature. Open Signing Requests from the menu.
steps.task: Click Signing Requests in the menu

steps.body: Create your first signing request. Name it and save. From here you can attach a document and track its signatures.
steps.task: Click New and save a signing request

steps.title: Where the automation lives
steps.body: Flows are what happens without anyone clicking: a reminder before a deadline passes, a confirmation sent on submission. This is where you read and edit them. Nothing to build now.

steps.title: Your first template is ready
steps.body: You have a template and a signing request. The Dashboard tracks them as your document workspace grows, and the documentation covers the rest.
steps.task: Open the documentation to keep going
